title: Trades on Track scholarship opens doors to skilled trades careers
body_markdown:
The skilled trades workforce keeps America's rail network and economy moving, and Norfolk Southern is investing in its future. Through a partnership with[SKILLED Nation](https://skilled-nation.org/) , our[Trades on Track Scholarship](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/commitments/in-your-community/community-impact/ns-scholarship-programs) helps students pursue careers in high-demand skilled trades by providing financial support for technical education, tools, and other education-related expenses.


**From the classroom to the workforce**


For 2025 scholarship recipients Amanda Lang and Mason Jones, their training has already translated into new opportunities. Both recently graduated from their respective programs and are now putting their skills to work.


### Amanda Lang


- 2025 Scholarship Recipient
- Graduated from Rosedale Technical College (May 2026)
- Now working as an electrician


*"My curiosity has grown into a clear direction. I want a career where I can work with my hands, solve problems, and make a real impact every day."*


### Mason Jones


- 2025 Scholarship Recipient
- Graduated from Modern Welding School (May 2026)
- Now working in the iron industry


*"After leaving the military, I was looking for a career with purpose, stability, and room to grow. I found that path in the skilled trades."*


**Applications are open**


This year, Norfolk Southern[expanded](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/story-yard/trades-on-track-scholarship-back--investing-in-skilled-trades) its investment in the Trades on Track Scholarship program to $250,000, providing 50 scholarships worth $5,000 each to support skilled trades education. The program is open to new and current students, as well as individuals looking to reskill or begin a new career.


Applications for the 2026 Trades on Track Scholarship are open through September 1, 2026. Learn more about the eligibility requirements and apply[here](https://webportalapp.com/sp/login/norfolk-southern_trades-on-track-scholarship) .
